At native and logical size, the fine shallow crown incision remains readable. The logical four-view sheet, repeated placement and light/gray/dark background previews show consistent visual weight with no material clipping, broken corners, halos, black patches, excessive grain, lateral lighting bias or directional ground shadows.

No new material visual defects were found in this corrected capture. The fixed target remains useful for diffuse soft illumination and tactile planar treatment, while its beige recoloring and altered geometry are appropriately not copied.
